result.title: The Only Edge Was Memorized in Training: LLM Trading Agents Around Earnings and Bad News
result.comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables. Original empirical study of LLM trading agents before scheduled earnings announcements and after bad-news drops, run on the rta-bench-1 benchmark (arXiv:2611.19530)
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents are tested on news, but news reaches stock prices within minutes, and a benchmark that replays headlines at their publication time finds no alpha in trading on them. Money can then remain in two places, before news whose date is known, such as earnings announcements, and after bad news, if the market's fall went too far. However, studies of LLMs and earnings read documents published with or after the announcement, and studies of reversal sort monthly portfolios, so neither tells whether an agent can trade these moments after costs. In this paper, we test LLM agents at both moments on the same look-ahead-free benchmark, before 598 earnings announcements and after 409 bad-news drops of large US stocks. Every input is cut at the decision close, staged agents are compared with single calls, simple rules and a logistic regression, and every decision is made with and without the stock's name. Across five models from four vendors, no agent beat the simple bets. Before earnings, the agents mostly bought and earned what buying before every announcement earned, and after bad news, a Gemini-based agent called almost every fall an overreaction while no agent picked better dips than buying them all. The only gains came from what the models had memorized in training. Given only the ticker and the dates, a GPT-based model called the direction of 59.2% of the announcements before its training cutoff and 53.3% after it. Agent builders should therefore compare an event agent with the simple bet and test it blind after the training cutoff.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在无前视偏误的基准上，考察多个 LLM 交易 agent 在财报公告前和坏消息暴跌后的决策，与单次调用、简单规则和逻辑回归对比，并设置是否提供股票名称的对照，发现表现未超过简单押注，收益主要来自模型训练中记住的信息。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「去掉关键输入的对照＋简单基线＋训练截止前后盲测」的评价思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中的答案是否真正使用了视觉或 latent 证据，还是依赖语言先验与记忆，而非推理本身。
